query.text: 请看着我分药，分完后汇总分好的药片数量及散落情况。
query.text_en: Please watch me sort the pills and, once I finish, summarize the number of sorted pills and any pills left outside the containers.

annotation.text_zh: 分好五粒整药和两瓣半药，一粒掉在桌上了。
annotation.text_en: You've sorted five whole pills and two halves, but one fell on the table.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
